Package arztis.econnector.common.model

Class RegisterParam

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.common.model.Parameter
arztis.econnector.common.model.RegisterParam
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
public class RegisterParam
extends Parameter
This class is used to pass details to register a user in ELGA. It can be used for
  • requesting IDA from SVC - for physicians with GINA
  • requesting IDA from ELGA - for hospitals
  • requesting HCP assertion
  • requesting context assertion
Author:
Anna Jungwirth

    • RegisterParam

      public RegisterParam​(java.lang.String givenName, java.lang.String familyName, java.lang.String role, java.lang.String cardReaderId, java.lang.String prefix, java.lang.String suffix, java.lang.String information, java.lang.String password, java.lang.String ordId, java.lang.String identityAssertion)
      Creates instance of RegisterParam.
      Parameters:
      givenName - given name of the real person, who wants to register
      familyName - family name of the real person, who wants to register
      role - role of the health care provider to register (Possible values are available under https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at (ELGA_GDA_Aggregatrollen))
      cardReaderId - ID of the card reader, which should be used to register with the Admin-Card
      prefix - prefix of the real person, who wants to register
      suffix - suffix of the real person, who wants to register
      information - additional information about the real person
      password - PIN of the Admin-Card
      ordId - ID of surgery to register
      identityAssertion - already existing IDA of the user
